concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payouts-payout-service-settle-funds]] — 2026-09-15 Payout Service guide for fee-net payable-batch internal settlement from merchant accounts to configured balance-platform accounts; example carries an unresolved SEK/EUR mismatch and does not establish beneficiary-bank receipt.
warnings: The hotel example states EUR 400.00 available in the SEK merchant account at raw line 48, while the input payment and later fee/net amounts are SEK (lines 43, 57–68); do not normalize the source or infer a conversion.
This internal merchant-to-balance-platform settlement is separate from onward Payout Service beneficiary disbursement and bank receipt.
